name: Bebe Stores, Inc.
summary: Bebe Stores, Inc. presently conducts very few operations. Historically, the company specialized in designing, developing, and manufacturing women's clothing and fashion accessories. Its merchandise was sold under the distinct "bebe" and "BEBE SPORT" brand names through various channels, including its retail boutiques, the bebe.com online store, and a network of 39 bebe outlet locations. Established in 1976, Bebe Stores, Inc. is headquartered in San Francisco, California. Since October 6, 2023, the entity has been operating as a subsidiary under B. Riley Financial, Inc.
